svg.title: CredData's dev split by kind of value: secrets caught against false values hit
svg.text: CredData's dev split by kind of value: secrets caught against false values hit
The repositories the fixes were made on: each labelled value, true or false, sorted by the ordinary-text chart's classifier. A false value is hit only if it is
redacted. Blue: redac---n (guessing off, confident, eager). Grey: other scanners; a line from gitleaks adds Betterleaks and Kingfisher, then TruffleHog
and Nosey Parker, then detect-secrets (the other six). Hollow: CredSweeper, which CredData's lines partly come from and whose model is trained on its labels.
√ scale across; up and left is better.
